_: GEAR I — racks, units, budgets (docs/SHIPS_AND_SKILLS.md §6.1-6.3, step S10, migration 0132).
_why: Authored here and guarded (scripts/db/world-guard.mjs), never migration-only. public.gear_racks, public.item_profile, the RACK rows of public.class_slots and public.class_slot_unlocks EQUAL this file, every column, both directions.
_racks: A rack takes ANY item of its rack (EVE). High = guns and boarding gear; Mid = sails, rudder, anchor, lookout, instruments; Low = hull, hold, pumps, sheathing; Refit = permanent refits (fitted at a build yard from S13, destroyed when removed); Flourish = the figurehead (no budget). `word` is what the player reads (docs/WORDS.md).
_items: The twelve live fittings are GRADE 1 of their base types (§6.3); effects untouched. deck / hands = what one mounted unit costs of the two fitting budgets (Deck = class_profile.deck, EVE's CPU; Hands = crew_max - ceil(crew_required / 2), EVE's powergrid). active = carries a trigger (S13 makes actives bite; until then every module is passive).
_classes: Slots by RACK per hull (§4.3 H/M/L/R + Flourish). The live typed counts convert exactly (barca H1/M2, carlat H2/M3, nau H3/M5/L1/F1 — 0074's rows summed by rack); Refit rows are new. A zero is simply no class_slots row.
_unlocks: 0127's level unlocks converted kind -> rack (barca lookout -> Mid @3, carlat hull -> Low @4, nau weapon -> High @6). Dark while levels_bite is off.
